query:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.avatar_url
               FROM friendships f
               JOIN users u ON u.id = CASE WHEN f.requester_id = $1 THEN f.addressee_id ELSE f.requester_id END
               WHERE f.status = 'accepted' AND (f.requester_id = $1 OR f.addressee_id = $1)
               ORDER BY u.username
